verdicts.title: Duplicated numbox-sqlite version-string computation across guard and error path
verdicts.reasoning: Read pysqlite_bridge.py directly. Line 106 inside libraries_coordinated(): `numbox_version = ctypes.c_char_p(sqlite3_libversion()).value.decode()`. Line 148 inside extract_connection_ptr() under the `if not libraries_coordinated():` block: `numbox_version = ctypes.c_char_p(sqlite3_libversion()).value.decode()`. The expressions are byte-for-byte identical. No helper function or caching exists. Confirmed via signatures.py line 109: `"sqlite3_libversion": intp()` — both sites wrap the same intp return in c_char_p identically. The error path calls sqlite3_libversion() a second time (the first call already ran inside libraries_coordinated()), and the two decode sites can drift independently. Finding holds as stated.
